impact_assessment.risks: contract: dash path ambiguity; dependency: none; concurrency: pipe may not close; state: two stdin operands
impact_assessment.mitigation: Reserve bare dash only for check, reject two dashes before reading, retain existing byte limits and test real pipes

impact_assessment.why: Long traces with a shared prefix are rejected even when the remaining comparison is small
impact_assessment.benefits: Compare common long traces while retaining bounded matrix allocation and existing tie semantics
impact_assessment.risks: contract: alignment ordering and cell budget; dependency: none; concurrency: immutable inputs; state: source index offsets
impact_assessment.mitigation: Keep the existing full-matrix align API, compare optimized results exhaustively against it on small cases, test long and over-budget residual traces

checkpoints.description: [1/4] Plan: complete structured difference reporting with order-independent CLI flags

impact_assessment.why: CI consumers of 'check --json' only receive the first difference; locating every divergence needs repeated runs or prose parsing, and flag order is brittle
impact_assessment.benefits: A versioned v2 JSON document with all differing rows, source lines and kind; flags in any order; a real --help; unchanged v1 output and exit codes
impact_assessment.risks: contract: JSON schema and CLI flag parsing; dependency: none; concurrency: stdin/pipes unchanged; state: snapshots stay immutable
impact_assessment.mitigation: Keep v1 bytes identical, gate v2 behind --all-differences requiring --json, refactor parsing behind pure helpers covered by the existing CLI regression suite, verify with the GNU toolchain

checkpoints.description: Agent reviewed the running CLI (help, v2 JSON, flag order, v1 parity, view navigation); 36 tests pass on GNU toolchain; all 5 project gates pass with RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN set
Task 'check-all-differences' completed successfully.

checkpoints.description: [1/3] Plan: keep the terminal context window full at the end of a comparison

impact_assessment.why: The renderer anchors its window to selected-3 and selected+4; near the last row the upper rows disappear, so context silently shrinks exactly where reviewers inspect the final difference
impact_assessment.benefits: A stable eight-row window with the cursor at either edge; earlier aligned rows remain visible while stepping to the last difference
impact_assessment.risks: contract: rendered rows in the terminal view; dependency: none; concurrency: immutable snapshots; state: navigation selection unchanged
impact_assessment.mitigation: Change only the window start calculation, add a failing-first pure renderer test for the last row, and keep existing navigation and rendering tests green

checkpoints.description: Failing-first renderer test added and fixed; running binary checked at the final row (8 rows, row 5 visible); UI task closed; 37 tests pass on GNU toolchain
Task 'view-window' completed successfully.
